proposals.title: Add over-top webbing anchors to retain the closed iPad independently of charging
proposals.body_md: Model a 25 mm non-stretch over-top keeper with upper/lower paired anchors, replace the rigid plug clamp with a loose-plug parking socket and separate lined cable anchor, and update the assembly to the three new v0.1.1 child heads. Connect the cable manually with slack; device restraint is independent of USB. StarTech USB2CC1M is the named candidate, but actual housing, jacket, device, buckle and mounting dimensions remain unmeasured. Three changed printed meshes pass watertight/single-body/print-envelope and posed-equivalence checks; assembly explodes; all four primary meshes pass PLM source rerender comparison. Schematic connected plug has zero volumetric interference with made parts. No failed/skipped checks. Warnings: all four child pins are unreleased; unchanged spacer and historical width/depth coupon retain older source copies. Four changed repos carry identical CAD source (older per-commit child check rows may still mention pre-update assembly). Spacer geometry/pin and quantities unchanged; coupon remains tied to its old target, not new validation evidence. Purchased strap/buckle/liners/cable are reference envelopes and unresolved purchasing requirements, not a complete order-ready structured BOM. See REVISION.md, DESIGN.md and the three refreshed review images. Candidate BOM changed, physical PBOM byte-identical; needs re-slice. No printing, purchasing, installation, merge or release performed. Human approval requested for this concept only; fit and travel/load qualification remain pending.
